reason: I shop before Eid, Ramadan and weddings, and in early November I have none of those coming up, so I'm not driving up from Sugar Land to buy a thobe I don't need yet. I'd probably put my name on the Ramadan early-access list and come back in late January to see the new pieces.
objection: From the description it sounds like standard embroidered thobes and plain everyday abayas. I worry the styles will be either too traditional Arab-looking or too basic for me, and I want something that feels new and a little more elevated each season.
would_change_my_mind: A wedding invitation in the next few weeks, plus photos showing their thobes and the Layla Bisht look are more modern and distinctive than what I already own.
